email_subject: Application - Customer Onboarding Manager at Teamleader
email_body:
Dear Teamleader team,

I'm applying for the Customer Onboarding Manager role for Teamleader Focus. I've spent the last years helping businesses get more out of their websites and digital tools, and I'd love to bring that experience to onboarding SMEs onto Focus.

In my current roles, I work directly with clients to understand how they operate and translate that into practical setups. At Episto, I manage CMS content and SEO for client sites, often explaining technical choices in plain language. As a freelancer, I build WordPress sites from scratch and guide clients through the process. I also have a technical background in front-end development, which helps me grasp product details quickly and have confident conversations about implementation.

I'm fluent in English and Turkish, with Dutch at B1 writing and A2+ speaking, and I'm eager to keep improving. I enjoy working with entrepreneurs, staying calm under pressure, and making sure every interaction ends with a clear next step.

I'd welcome the chance to discuss how I can help new customers start strong with Teamleader Focus.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I'm excited to apply for the Customer Onboarding Manager position at Teamleader. Your mission to make work easier for SMEs resonates with me, and I'd love to contribute to helping new customers get off to a strong start with Teamleader Focus.

In my current roles as a freelance web specialist and junior digital marketer at Episto, I work closely with clients to understand their business needs and translate them into practical digital solutions. Whether it's building a WordPress site from scratch, optimizing SEO, or managing content, I focus on making technology work for the people using it. I've guided clients through website builds and improvements, explaining technical aspects in clear, non-technical language and ensuring they feel confident with the result. This experience has taught me to listen carefully, ask the right questions, and adapt to different business contexts.

My technical background in front-end development (AngularJS, JavaScript) and my daily use of AI tools give me a solid foundation for understanding product details and troubleshooting issues. I'm comfortable handling technical questions and using data to spot trends, which I believe is valuable for proactive onboarding. I also enjoy working with entrepreneurs and understand the challenges they face, from time constraints to the need for practical, results-oriented solutions.

I'm fluent in English and Turkish, with Dutch at B1 writing and A2+ speaking, and I'm committed to improving my Dutch further. I stay calm under pressure and adapt quickly when priorities shift, qualities I've developed through managing multiple client projects simultaneously.

I'm eager to bring my mix of customer-facing experience, technical understanding, and commercial mindset to Teamleader. I'd welcome the opportunity to discuss how I can help new customers succeed with Focus.

Warm regards,
